name: adk-kit
description: Google ADK agent apps where numbers must be trustworthy: architecture rules (layers, figures with provenance, the turn ledger, number verification, the analyst-agent-in-a-shell pattern), A2UI surfaces rendered in React, and A2UI integration end to end (patterns, SSE or A2A transport, actions, security, restricted-environment deployment), plus ADK 2.x (google-adk 2.11) workflow, app-runtime and testing skills with tested examples and canary tests, for use alongside google-agents-cli. Pairs with the specfirst plugin, which carries the spec-first workflow. Skills follow the open Agent Skills format.
